title: Expelled from Paradise: Resonance Anime Movie Reveals Key Visual, Teaser Trailer
content:
The previously announced Expelled from Paradise: Resonance anime movie revealed a key visual and teaser trailer at AnimeJapan 2026. Toei Animation is animating the series.

See more AnimeJapan 2026 updates: AnimeJapan 2026 All Announcements and Highlights

Seiji Mizushima is directing the film and Gen Urobuchi (NITROPLUS) is in charge of the screenplay. Masatsugu Saito is providing the character designs, with the mechanical designs done by Kanetake Ebikawa, Junya Ishigaki and Takayuki Yanase. NARASAKI is composing the music. The main cast includes:

• Ayane Sakura as Gabriel

• Saori Hayami as Arma

• Yoshino Aoyama as Daniel

• Sally Amaki as Raguel

Aniplex of USA has licensed the original Expelled from Paradise movie for its North American theatrical release, as well as for its Blu-Ray/DVD release. They describe the plot as follows: With Earth now left in ruins following the “Nano Hazard,” most of humanity has abandoned the planet they once called home along with their physical bodies and rebuilt their digitalized minds into a society within the cyber universe of “DEVA.” A.D. 2400, DEVA’s central council detects an incident of unauthorized access into their mainframe. Someone on Earth was trying to hack into the system. The only information DEVA was able to retrieve was that the hacker referred to themselves as “Frontier Setter.” To investigate the mysterious hacker’s motives, the high officials of DEVA dispatch System Security Third Officer Angela Balzac to the Earth’s surface. Equipped with a prosthetic “material body,” Angela attempts to make contact with a local agent Dingo, but what awaited her instead was a swarm of Sandworms now infesting the Earth’s surface. Angela intercepts the gruesome pests with her exoskeletal powered suit Arhan. Will Angela and Dingo be able to find Frontier Setter on this devastated planet? Their journey to explore the secrets of the world will begin now…!

title: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Anime Reveals New Key Visual, October 23 Premiere
content:
Made in Abyss anime revealed a new key visual for Part 1 of its theatrical film series, Awakening Mystery . The first installment is set to premiere in Japan on October 23, 2026.

It was also announced that ahead of the new film series, previous Made in Abyss recap movies and entries will receive theatrical re-screenings in Japan. This includes the compilation films Journey’s Dawn and Wandering Twilight , along with Dawn of the Deep Soul and the TV anime sequel The Golden City of the Scorching Sun .

You can see the new visual below.

The anime movie previously revealed a teaser visual , featuring two new characters, Tepaste and Cravagli, shown at the Tumble Tavern. The new film will serve as a direct continuation of the 2022 TV anime Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun . Kinema Citrus returns as the animation studio, continuing its involvement from the previous entries in the series. The staff includes:

• Director: Masayuki Kojima

• Screenplay: Hideyuki Kurata

• Character Design: Yuka Kuroda, Kazuchika Kise (Production I.G)

• Animation Production: Kinema Citrus

The confirmed voice cast includes:

• Miyu Tomita as Riko

• Mariya Ise as Reg

• Shiori Izawa as Nanachi

• Misaki Kuno as Faputa

You can watch the first trailer below.

Made in Abyss , written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, follows the descent of a girl named Riko and a robot boy named Reg into the Abyss, a massive pit filled with ancient relics and mysterious creatures. Yasuharu Takanashi ( Fairy Tail ) and Johannes Nilsson ( Tsukimichi -Moonlit Fantasy- ) is back to compose the music, with Pony Canyon producing.

You Natsuki serves as the sub-character designer, and Atsushi Shibata and jimao are designing the props. Yū Okimoto replaces Nozomu Ōma as the compositing director of photography. Tomoki Murakami is handling the 2D and visual effects.
Fumiyuki Gō replaces Shūhei Abe as sound director, and Bit Groove Promotion replaces Saber Links on sound production.

Lulucy Luu (as voiced by Shino Shimoji ) and Tier ( Aya Suzaki ) once again perform an opening theme song, “It's a beautiful story,” and Yui Hizuki is also back with a new ending theme song, “Sunny Steps.”
One Peace Books began releasing Yasuyuki Tsurugi 's manga adaptation of the novels in November 2020, and it describes the story:

After Hiraku dies of a serious illness, God brings him back to life, gives his health and youth back, and sends him to a fantasy world of his choice. In order to enjoy his second shot, God bestows upon him the almighty farming tool! Watch as Hiraku digs, chops, and ploughs in another world in this laidback farming fantasy!
The first season premiered on the AT-X channel on January 6, 2023 at 9:00 p.m. (7:00 a.m. EST), and it also ran on TV Tokyo and BS TV Tokyo . HIDIVE streamed the anime as it airs in Japan.

Naito began serializing the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2016, where it is ongoing. Kadokawa began publishing the novels in print with illustrations by Yasumo ( Banished From The Heroes' Party ) in October 2017, and published the 20th novel on February 28. Tsurugi launched the manga in 2017, and Kadokawa published the 16th volume on March 9.

A four-panel comedy spinoff manga titled Isekai Nonbiri Nōka no Nichijō ( Farming Life in Another World : Daily Life) by Yuji launched in Kadokawa 's Dragon Age magazine on July 8, 2022, and the seventh volume shipped on March 9.

title: 'Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku ( Sparks of Tomorrow ) Blue Stage revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, second key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Sunday. The anime, adapting Hiro Yuuki 's historical romance light novel , is scheduled to premiere on July 5 at 11:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11, ABC TV, and TV Aichi.

Cast Suzu Harashima: You Taichi ( Majo to Yajuu ) Kate Ookura: Natsumi Kawaida ( Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. ) Yajirou Yagura: Kazuki Ura ( Gachiakuta ) Izou Masubushi: Daisuke Hirakawa ( Kimetsu no Yaiba )

Staff Art Director: Mao Takayama ( Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S background art) Color Design: Fuyuki Ootsuka Prop Design: Aya Hikita ( Hibike! Euphonium 3 key animation) Director of Photography: Kouki Ueda ( City The Animation ) 3D Director: Mitsuki Takaki Sound Director: Youta Tsuruoka ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ) Music Production: Lantis , Heart Company

Singer-songwriter Luna Goami ( Shuumatsu Touring ending theme) is performing the opening theme "Eureka Evrika," which is previewed in the promotional video below. American singer-songwriter Ginger Root performs the ending theme.

Minoru Oota ( Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S episode director) is helming the anime at Kyoto Animation . The light novel won Honorable Mention at the 8th Kyoto Animation Award in 2017. Yuuki published the title under Kyoto Animation KA Esuma Bunko label with illustrations by Kazumi Ikeda ( Hibike! Euphonium 3 character design) in August 2018.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Film's Teaser Reveals October 16 Release Date
content: Aniplex unveiled a new teaser trailer for Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai (Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend) film, the latest anime adaptation of Hajime Kamoshida's Rascal Does Not Dream (Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, during its stage event for the film at AnimeJapan 2026 on Sunday. The teaser reveals the film's October 16 date. Image courtesy of Aniplex©2025 鴨志田 一/KADOKAWA/青ブタ ProjectAniplex also revealed a new version of the film's previously unveiled visual (shown right) which contains the release date.The film's returning cast includes:Kaito Ishikawa as Sakuta AzusagawaAsami Seto as Mai SakurajimaSora Amamiya as Uzuki HirokawaAya Yamane as Ikumi AkagiKonomi Kohara as Sara HimejiManaka Iwami as Miori MitōReina Ueda as Nene IwamizawaNao Tōyama as Tomoe KogaAtsumi Tanezaki as Rio FutabaMaaya Uchida as Nodoka ToyohamaYurika Kubo as Kaede AzusagawaInori Minase as Shōko MakinoharaSōichi Masui returns to direct the film at CloverWorks. Masahiro Yokotani is also back to oversee and write the script, and Satomi Tamura is again designing the characters. The band fox capture plan also returns to compose the music. Aniplex is once again distributing the film. The new film is teased as taking the story towards its finale. (The film shares the same name as the 15th and final novel volume.)Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai (Seishun Buta Yarō wa Bunny Girl-senpai no Yume wo Minai), the first television anime based on the light novel series, premiered in Japan in October 2018 and aired for 13 episodes. The anime adapts the story up to the fifth novel volume. Aniplex of America streamed the series on Crunchyroll, Funimation, and other services.Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl (Seishun Buta Yarō wa Yume-Miru Shōjo no Yume wo Minai), the anime film that adapts the the sixth and seventh light novel volumes in the franchise, opened in Japan in June 2019. Aniplex of America and Funimation Films screened the anime in the United States. Crunchyroll began streaming the film on June 19 with both English subtitles and dub.The first film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out opened in Japan in June 2023. The film sold 118,108 tickets in its first three days and earned 175,648,924 yen (about US$1.28 million) to rank #4 in its opening weekend. Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid, the second film, opened in Japan in December 2023, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 119,000 tickets and earned 164,594,554 yen (about US$1.11 million) in its first three days.Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus (Seishun Buta Yarō wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai), the television anime adapting the light novel series' "University Student Arc," premiered on July 5. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and is also streaming an English dub.The original novel series has over 3 million copies in circulation. The Yen On imprint of Yen Press publishes the novel series, and Yen Press publishes Tsugumi Nanamiya's manga adaptation. Yen On will publish the Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend novel volume on January 6.Sources: AnimeJapan 2026 panel, press release, Disclosure: Kadokawa World Entertainment (KWE), a wholly owned subsidiary of Kadokawa Corporation, is the majority owner of Anime News Network, LLC. contentBlocks.text: Aniplex unveiled a new teaser trailer for Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai ( Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend ) film, the latest anime adaptation of Hajime Kamoshida 's Rascal Does Not Dream ( Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, during its stage event for the film at AnimeJapan 2026 on Sunday. The teaser reveals the film's October 16 date.
Aniplex also revealed a new version of the film's previously unveiled visual (shown right) which contains the release date.
The film's returning cast includes:
- Kaito Ishikawa as Sakuta Azusagawa
- Asami Seto as Mai Sakurajima
- Sora Amamiya as Uzuki Hirokawa
- Aya Yamane as Ikumi Akagi
- Konomi Kohara as Sara Himeji
- Manaka Iwami as Miori Mitō
- Reina Ueda as Nene Iwamizawa
- Nao Tōyama as Tomoe Koga
- Atsumi Tanezaki as Rio Futaba
- Maaya Uchida as Nodoka Toyohama
- Yurika Kubo as Kaede Azusagawa
- Inori Minase as Shōko Makinohara

Sōichi Masui returns to direct the film at CloverWorks . Masahiro Yokotani is also back to oversee and write the script, and Satomi Tamura is again designing the characters. The band fox capture plan also returns to compose the music. Aniplex is once again distributing the film.
The new film is teased as taking the story towards its finale. (The film shares the same name as the 15th and final novel volume.)

Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Bunny Girl-senpai no Yume wo Minai ), the first television anime based on the light novel series, premiered in Japan in October 2018 and aired for 13 episodes. The anime adapts the story up to the fifth novel volume. Aniplex of America streamed the series on Crunchyroll , Funimation , and other services.

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Yume-Miru Shōjo no Yume wo Minai ), the anime film that adapts the the sixth and seventh light novel volumes in the franchise , opened in Japan in June 2019. Aniplex of America and Funimation Films screened the anime in the United States. Crunchyroll began streaming the film on June 19 with both English subtitles and dub .

The first film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out opened in Japan in June 2023. The film sold 118,108 tickets in its first three days and earned 175,648,924 yen (about US$1.28 million) to rank #4 in its opening weekend. Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid , the second film, opened in Japan in December 2023, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 119,000 tickets and earned 164,594,554 yen (about US$1.11 million) in its first three days.

Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai ), the television anime adapting the light novel series' "University Student Arc," premiered on July 5. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and is also streaming an English dub .

The original novel series has over 3 million copies in circulation. The Yen On imprint of Yen Press publishes the novel series, and Yen Press publishes Tsugumi Nanamiya 's manga adaptation. Yen On will publish the Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend novel volume on January 6.

title: 'Gensou Suikoden' Announces Supporting Cast
content:
The Gensou Suikoden ( Suikoden: The Anime ) White Stage at AnimeJapan 2026 revealed supporting cast members and a fourth key visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime series adapting Konami's fantasy role-playing game will begin airing in October 2026.

Cast Culgan: Jun Kasama ( Revenger ) Seed: Yoshitsugu Matsuoka ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Leknaat: Megumi Han ( Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari ) Gengen: Shouta Hayama ( Tokyo Revengers ) Rikimaru: Ryuunosuke Watanuki ( Blue Lock ) Rina: Saya Hitomi ( Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite ) Eilie: Umino Mizutama Bolgan: Yuusuke Sasaki ( Dandadan )

Yuuzou Satou ( Exception ) is helming the anime at Konami animation . Michihiro Tsuchiya ( Major 2nd 2nd Season ) is handling the series composition and Ryou Yamauchi ( Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai ) is designing the characters. Kouji Nakamura ( Eureka Seven AO ) is composing the music.

The Suikoden franchise debuted in 1995 on the PlayStation, drawing inspiration from the classic Chinese novel Shui Hu Zhuan ( Water Margin ). Konami released Gensou Suikoden II ( Suikoden II ) in December 1998, followed by three more games in the main series in July 2002, August 2004, and February 2006 as well as multiple spin-offs.

Shinjirou Hori penned a light novel adaptation under Kadokawa's Dengeki Bunko imprint with illustrations by Fumi Ishikawa from December 2000 to September 2001.

contentBlocks.text: The anime will star:
- Yume Miyamoto as Melody Wave
- Rumi Ōkubo as Luciana Rudleberg
- Kōhei Amasaki will voice Christopher Von Théolas
EMT Squared is producing the anime.
Seven Seas licensed and releases both the original novels and the manga adaptation. The company describes the story:

"I will become the world's most wonderful maid!" With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count's family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic. Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

Atekichi launched the ongoing light novel series on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in February 2017. TO Books started publishing the novels with illustration by Yukiko in March 2020. Keiko launched the manga adaptation of the series on TO Books ' Corona EX website in March 2022. The light novels' ninth volume will ship on April 1. The manga's seventh volume will ship on July 1.

title: 'Baki-dou' Second Part Announced
content:
The Baki-dou Blue Stage at AnimeJapan 2026 announced a second part on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) and teaser promotional video. The second part will be released worldwide exclusively on Netflix.

TMS Entertainment adapted the Hanma Baki prequel manga into two anime seasons on Netflix—the first season debuted with 12 episodes in September 2021 and the second season streamed in 27 episodes from July to August in 2023.

A crossover anime movie between the Hanma Baki and Kengan Ashura anime premiered worldwide on Netflix in June 2024. The first part of Baki-dou premiered on Netflix on February 26.

Keisuke Itagaki began serializing Baki-dou , the fourth main entry in the martial arts manga series, in Shounen Champion in March 2014 and ended it in April 2018.

A sequel manga, also titled Baki-dou ( Baki-dou 2 ), ran in the same magazine from October 2018 to June 2023, followed by Baki Rahen , which began in August 2023. The sixth volume was published on February 6.

content:
• The Isekai Nonbiri Nouka 2 ( Farming Life in Another World Season 2 ) AnimeJapan 2026 stage event at the Pony Canyon booth revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured right), and a second promotional video on Sunday. The second season adapting Kinosuke Naitou 's fantasy slice of life light novel will air at 10.30 p.m. on AT-X followed by, TV Tokyo, BS TV Tokyo, and Tulip TV on April 6.

Cast Majin (The Demon God): Hikaru Midorikawa ( Black Clover ) Jack: Rikuya Yasuda ( Beelzebub-jou no Okinimesu mama. ) Morte: Eri Yukimura ( Blue Lock ) Bell Forgma: Mariko Honda ( Kami no Tou ) Gou Forgma: Yasuhiro Mamiya ( Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia Illegals ) Kuzden: Fumiya Imai ( Given )

Ryouichi Kuraya ( Tsugumomo ) is directing the anime and handling the series composition and script at Zero-G . Yoshiko Saitou ( Kubo-san wa Mob wo Yurusanai ) is designing the characters, with Johannes Nilsson ( Kaifuku Jutsushi no Yarinaoshi ) (Team-MAX) and Yasuharu Takanashi ( Tsuki ga Michibiku Isekai Douchuu ) (Team-MAX) composing the music.

Produced by Zero-G, the first season aired in Winter 2023. HIDIVE streamed the anime with subtitles and an English dub.

Naitou began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in December 2016. Kadokawa began publishing the novel with illustrations by Yasumo in October 2017 and released the 20th volume on February 28. Isekai Nonbiri Nouka has a cumulative 5.7 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Yasuyuki Tsurugi began drawing a manga adaptation on the ComicWalker website in October 2017. Kadokawa published the 16th volume on March 9.

One Peace Books licensed the manga in English in September 2020 and published the 11th volume in November 2025, with the 12th scheduled to be released on June 23.

title: 'One Piece: Heroines' Unveils Cast Pair, Promo
content:
The One Piece Red Stage event at AnimeJapan 2026 unveiled a cast pair and a promotional video for One Piece: Heroines anime on Saturday. The anime adapting Jun Esaka 's adventure fantasy light novel will premiere at 11.15 a.m. on July 5.

Voice actors Takehito Koyasu ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) and Maaya Sakamoto ( Enen no Shouboutai ) are joining the cast as Lubno and Miucca, respectively.

Haruka Kamatani ( Majo Minarai wo Sagashite ) is helming the anime, with Momoka Toyoda ( One Piece Fan Letter ) writing the script. Takashi Kojima ( Kimi to Nami ni Noretara ) is designing the characters.

Esaka penned the adventure fantasy light novel with illustration by Sayaka Suwa in One Piece Magazine from December 2019 to September 2023. Shueisha published the second and final volume in March 2024.

VIZ Media licensed the novel for English release in May 2024, and published the second volume in July 2025.

title: 'Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 3rd Season' Announces Additional Cast
content:
• The Tokyo MX Booth at AnimeJapan 2026 announced an additional cast pair for Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 3rd Season ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You Season 3 ) on Saturday. The new season is scheduled to premiere in July 2026.

Voice actresses Kaori Ishihara ( Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. ) and Ayana Taketatsu ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e ) are joining the cast as Chiyo Iin and Nadeshiko Yamato, respectively.

Produced by Bibury Animation Studios , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2023. The second season premiered in Winter 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo , also known as Hyakkano , adapts Rikito Nakamura and Yukiko Nozawa 's comedy harem manga , which they launched in Young Jump magazine in December 2019. Shueisha published the 25th volume on March 18. Hyakkano has a cumulative 2.2 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English under its Ghost Ship imprint in July 2021. The 17th volume went on sale on March 17, with the 18th volume scheduled for a June 23 release.

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo for Fall 2026
content:
The Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) Red Stage at AnimeJapan 2026 revealed the main cast, staff, teaser promotional video, and a key visual (pictured) on Saturday. The anime adapting CLAMP 's mahou shoujo manga is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame at 11.45 p.m. in October 2026.

Cast Hikaru Shidou: Ayane Sakura ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu ) Fuu Hououji: Rie Takahashi ( [Oshi no Ko] ) Umi Ryuuzaki: Rumi Ookubo ( Mayonaka Heart Tune )

Staff Director: Yui Umemoto ( Ninja Kamui ) Series Composition: Shigeru Murakoshi ( Apocalypse Hotel ) Character Design: Satomi Watanabe ( Aikatsu! ) Music: Yuki Kajiura ( Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica ), Takumi Ozawa ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ), Shiho Terada ( Inazuma Eleven Go ) Planning, Production: Unlimited Produce by TMS Studio: E&H Production

CLAMP serialized the manga in Nakayoshi magazine from November 1993 to February 1995. A sequel manga began in the same month and ended in March 1996.

Tokyopop licensed both manga in 1997, followed by Dark Horse Comics in 2009, and then Kodansha USA in 2019 with two hard-cover box sets containing three volumes each.
